links.comparator_used: External model trained on a large cohort, applied as-is to the local cohort without transfer learning
links.outcome: AUROC for neurological outcome prediction after out-of-hospital cardiac arrest
links.effect: Vietnam (243 patients): AUROC 0.467 (95% CI 0.141-0.785) for the external model vs 0.807 (95% CI 0.626-0.948) with transfer learning. Singapore (15,916 patients): AUROC 0.945 vs 0.955 with transfer learning.
links.quote: The external model performed poorly on the Vietnam cohort, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.467 (95% CI: 0.141-0.785), but TL markedly improved performance (AUROC = 0.807, 95% CI: 0.626-0.948).

design_hint: local recalibration/adaptation via transfer learning before deployment
